entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer service. My name is Amy. How may I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I want to return this VeloBand Pulse. It’s not working properly. The heart rate readings are all over the place!
I understand. I'm sorry you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. Can I please get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?

Thank you, Sarah. I've located your order. I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse on July 18th, and today is July 3rd... Wait sorry that is a typo. You purchased on July 18th, and today is August 2nd. To confirm, you're looking to return it for a full refund?
Yes, exactly! I need my money back! This thing is useless.
I understand your frustration, Sarah. Let me check our return policy for the VeloBand Pulse. Our standard return window for electronics is 10 days from the date of purchase.
Ten days?! Seriously? I've only had it for a little over two weeks! That's ridiculous! I want to speak to a manager!

I understand your disappointment, Sarah. Unfortunately, the return window is firm. However, while a full refund isn't possible, I can explore other options. Let me see if a policy exception is possible.
Well, what other options are there? I don't want to be stuck with a broken device.

While a refund is outside the return window, I can offer you store credit for the full purchase price of the VeloBand Pulse. This store credit can be used towards any other VeloFit product. How does that sound?
Store credit, huh? So I can get something else? Like a different model of tracker?

Yes, absolutely. You can use the store credit towards any item in our store, including a different fitness tracker or accessories. The VeloBand Pulse has been popular, but we have other options you might like.
Okay… store credit… I guess that’s better than nothing. How does that work?

I'll process the store credit now and send you an email with a unique code. You can use that code at checkout when you're ready to make another purchase. It will cover the full cost of the VeloBand Pulse you returned, minus any shipping fees, of course. There is no expiry date on the credit. Is there anything else that I can assist you with today?
No, I think that covers it. Thanks for figuring something out. I appreciate it.
You're very welcome, Sarah. I'm glad we could find a solution. The email with your store credit code should arrive within the next few minutes. Have a great day and thank you for choosing VeloFit!
